content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for NIT Rourkela PDF recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Post-Doctoral Fellowship (PDF) positions at NIT Rourkela is scheduled for 24 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they are present at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Post-Doctoral Fellowship?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a PhD in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, or Industrial Design. A submitted PhD thesis or completed PhD within the last year is also acceptable, along with first-class academic records.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Post-Doctoral Fellowship position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Post-Doctoral Fellowship is 35 years. Age relaxations are applicable for SC/ST/PWD/Female and OBC candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Post-Doctoral Fellowship?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 50,000/-. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Post-Doctoral Fellowship?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Post-Doctoral Fellowship (PDF) position at NIT Rourkela.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs to the interview venue.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Post-Doctoral Fellowship?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on their merit and performance in a walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at National Institute of Technology Rourkela, Rourkela, Odisha - 769008.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any preference for specific skills?
faq.answer: Yes, desirable skills include 3D Modelling in SolidWorks, FEM Simulation in ANSYS/COMSOL, and MATLAB Programming with Hardware.
